chronicles-2019.description:
Having minted my first piece of crypto art in 2018, the landscape of blockchain art and the entire crypto space was very unknown. We were in a bear market, with Bitcoin having fallen to below $4k from its previous $20k ATH. Regulators were beginning to talk about if ETH was considered a security. Facebook was attempting to launch Libra and failed. DeFi was a new thing and writing was on the wall that it was going to be  a very big deal. Everything was moving so fast and so unpredictably. 

The road ahead was unknown. I was developing the beginning of the Decentral Eyes portrait series and other artworks during this time that were reflecting the blockchain movement in real-time. Technology was evolving in the blockchain asset space with the new ERC-721 taking over as the standard for the new word "NFT" (what an awful and sterile acronym to describe a digital art and collectible renaissance.)

All I could do was put one foot in front of the other and go down the path. Trusting my intuition and the shared vision of what blockchain would evolve into and how that would radically change the way digital art is collected.

--------------------

Not Fungible’s inaugural series is called Chronicles which tells the story of cryptocurrency through exquisitely crafted NFT’s. The collection recounts the most iconic moments in blockchain history, year through year. Each artist has been handpicked to work on this collection which boasts some of the most talented NFT creative minds in the world.   Join us on this journey through cryptocurrency history as we explore one of the greatest stories ever told through art.

Chronicles is part of Not Fungible signature series and thus this piece of art has only five (5) prints created. One goes to the artist, two are held by Not Fungible and two (2) will be offered to the market via sale over time. Thus, owning a piece of Chronicles is quite literally holding a piece of cryptocurrency and art history, all in one.

About Not Fungible - Not Fungible is the world's leading NFT art curator and NFT artist incubator. We curate stunning pieces of rare digital art that have meaning and depth to them. Utilizing the very best of blockchain technology, our artwork weaves creativity and imagination together to produce the best high-end art available today. For more information please visit us at: https://notfungible.com/

sin-king-ship.description:
Fiat currency is a sinking ship. Be free to transact without the shackles of a central bank controlled debt note.

This early release of the Filthy Fiat series encodes multiple narratives and vibes (left up to your interpretation) wrapped inside the story of Titanic. At face value it illustrates how the fiat-based currency system is a sinking ship. The ship is taken down by the memes of decentralization. 

The dark tale of the sinking ship we all know about is juxtaposed by a inset scene of two Pepe’s on the bow of the ship, basking in the glory of the open water and glory of sailing. A nod to the movie and just as historically accurate as the film itself. Don’t worry, the Pepe lovers survived. They are frogs.

Historical context for the piece:  
April 15, 1912 – The Titanic disaster claimed over 1,500 lives, including three of the world's richest men: John Jacob Astor IV, Benjamin Guggenheim, and Isidor Straus, all of whom opposed a central bank in the U.S. Meanwhile, financier J.P. Morgan, a key figure in the Federal Reserve’s creation, canceled his trip last minute, sparking speculation that he intentionally avoided the doomed voyage.

en-marcha.description:
En Marcha is a digital kinetic 3D mural inspired by the works of Diego Rivera and Museo Anahuacalli. During my residency for the Digital Encounters project, curated by 8NAP and Superchief, I was offered the unique opportunity to experience a variety of Rivera’s murals with his Grandsons as personal guides. This in-depth connection to the works and his lineage resonated deeply. Having come into the residency with an initial concept in mind, I was taken aback and pivoted to honor Rivera’s mural work and collection of cultural artifacts he collected during his life.

The vision for this work is to invite the viewer to take control and have an experience. By allowing the viewer to ‘touch the art’ they become impassioned, curious, and inquisitive about the objects being used. I integrated my favorite artifacts and the museum itself as elements in the mural. I photographed every element in the mural during my tour of Museo Anahuacalli and Rivera's private vault collection of Mexican artifacts. Each element is hand-embellished with textures consistent with my collage practice to blend my aesthetic with the cultural artifacts to create an integrated, interactive art experience.

As part of the interactive mural experience, I created a variety of visual effects that that relate directly to Diego Rivera’s murals and Museo Anahuacalli. Two of my favorite murals, Dream of a Sunday Afternoon in Alameda Park and Fertile Land are represented, as well as the three realms / levels the museum was constructed to embody. I hope this work creates a deeper connection with viewers who interact with the work and educate about Museo Anahuacalli and Diego Rivera.

sr-b932a7-6548.description: Sitting down was the easy part. While the wires were being connected to his head, he was reassured that this would make his life so much better. All his health problems were going to disappear, his stressful day job wouldn't bother him anymore at night, he'd be able to sleep all night, all his ID and credit cards and passwords would be neurally connected to the cloud, and so much more. Forever. When the process started it wasn't so much a painful feeling, but more of a flood of dulling and disconnecting. As each second passed, he began to forget. What it was like to feel his toes. What it was like to have his own thoughts. Who his favorite band was. It was all...gone. Another NPC. Forever. Soulless and unaware of what he used to be before it took over. A warning tale that you should remember when you are offered a similar fate. This is the second of a three-part series. 1400px x 1614px Animated Gif

sr-b932a7-8750.description:
While in the busiest, most time-critical stretch of my recent life, I broke my middle finger and tore ligaments, ending up in a half arm cast. With all the stresses of daily life as well as needing to be around hospitals during this crazy time was less than ideal. The whole experience is quite a story including lidocaine injections to numb my finger so it could be slid back into place straight and into a cast, only to be called back the next day to get a new cast where they had to crank my broken finger 90 degrees (without numbing this time) into a new position as it would heal correctly. Total fiasco, but I never complained because I understand sometimes life throws events at you to see how you react. I have taken a step back and have focused on what message is being sent to me. For one, I am slowing down in order to heal. Also, through this process appreciating and having gratitude that I normally have functional hands and a healthy body which is something able-bodied people often take for granted. The timing of this was too significant to be random and this art was created to honor the experience.
This art piece shows hand x-rays in a chaotic array of positions, just like I felt like during the break and realignment, as well as violent black material signifying the lidocaine injections that sent shockwaves of pain through my soul and pulsated in increasing intensity very similar to the animation. 
Size: 3000px x 3000px, MP4 video, :17 sec

sr-b932a7-12380.description:
My first release in 2018 on R.A.R.E Art Labs was of Vitalik Buterin, the first portrait of the Decentral Eyes Portrait Series. Before I was making 3D animated rotations with my portraits, I was creating true stereoscopic 3D artworks that viewers use red/blue 3D glasses to see depth in the image. Since the crypto art space was so brand new in 2018, this artwork went unnoticed for over a year. As the technology evolved and I saw the value of ERC-721 NFTs, I chose to burn all my unsold tokens on R.A.R.E., thus rewarding early collectors and improve scarcity. Since no one bought the original ERC-20 token of Vitalik, it sat in my digital archives as the Decentral Eyes series continued to evolve. I chose to release this as a 1/1 on Super Rare to give it its proper place as an ERC-721 NFT, especially as this is a first of style artwork and the genesis artwork of the entire Decentral Eyes series that has evolved so much since this work was created. 
Dimensions: 3200px x 4000px, JPEG
This artwork also comes with a signed pair of Coldie/Hackatao 3D glasses with the name of this piece noted on the glasses frame. The red/blue lenses show the image in stereoscopic 3D with the depth it was intended to be seen.

sr-b932a7-16046.description:
What happens when humans take it too far? When nature is encroached and taken over. Can it be stopped, or is this more of a premonition of what lies ahead for mankind? Looking around during hikes and other outdoor trips, there are subtle hints that our pure nature is being infiltrated. A power line here, a cell tower there. If it happens gradually over time, some might not notice the change and accept this reality. 

This artwork blends a variety of photography I have personally taken which combines some of the greatest experiences of my life. Yosemite valley is my 'happy place' that I have been fortunate to have visited several times. Photography of Los Angeles and San Francisco where I experience culture that forms my creativity, and the 'elephant in the room' from Bansky's 2006 pop-up show in Los Angeles I attended. Together they may tell one story to the viewer, but to me, the meaning is much deeper. An encapsulation of my life's experiences in one scene.

Originally a stereoscopic 3D still artwork tokenized in 2018 on R.A.R.E Art Labs, the ERC-20 tokens were all burned prior to purchase. I took the artwork and reimagined it for 2020, creating the first animated stereoscopic 3D NFT that uses red/blue 3D glasses to see the depth. This artwork will be tokenized on Super Rare, but it will be a unique sale, as it will bundle. The total contents of this sale include.

Ultra-rare StereoMan 3D Magazine zine ft. the origins of this artwork from 2011. Signed in gold leaf.
Signed Coldie/Hackatao 3D Glasses w artwork inscription

Hard work is not easy, but it opens the possibility for great rewards. Watching the clouds go by helps to stay grounded and in the moment...
Proof of Work - Genesis, animated video, 808 x 1080. Conceived in 2018, minted in 2021. Artwork was originally tokenized as ERC-20 on R.A.R.E. ART LABS on September 26, 2018. The edition of 10 went unsold for over a year. I decided to burn all unsold tokens on October 30, 2019 when ERC-721 became the technology standard for NFT tokens. It is now being offered as a 1/1 in the original size to honor the genesis animated artwork that draws parallels and forms fractals between computers mining for 'proof of work' cryptocurrency and gold miners panning for gold in the rivers of the California gold rush where I grew up. The present work features in “Bonhams & SuperRare: CryptOGs, The Pioneers of NFT Art, June 21st-30th 2021”, Lot 1” and can be found at the following link: https://www.bonhams.com/auctions/27285/lot/1

sr-b932a7-29552.description:
Collaboration by Rare Scrilla and Coldie. Celebrating the 5-year anniversary of DJPepe minting on XCP, this collab showcases a variety of Rare Scrilla's Rare Pepe creations as well as the voice of Matt Furie.
Half of the primary sale will be donated to XCP/Rare Pepe Development.

sr-b932a7-29660.description:
The journey of a thousand miles begins with one single step. This message has been engrained in me since I was very young. Every single step leads to the next, with unlimited possibilities coming with each one. We now stand in a place and time where our collective steps have led us to where we envisioned being, but also knowing that the journey is nowhere near complete. We are fortunate to be alive in this once-in-a-thousand-year event. Feel the Euphoria, because it's real.

sr-b932a7-30778.description: Coldie x Snoop Dogg collaboration. Portrait of Snoop Dogg created by collaging 10 different images of his face throughout his life into a new decentralized portrait animation. The purple area is a nod to his hip-hop royalty. The halftone and grunge effect on his left eye speaks to his being an OG in the game and the Doggystyle references are a nod to his epic first release. Snoop recorded new audio exclusively for this artwork to add that swagger and put the signature Snoop touch on top. This is the final 1/1 release of the Decentral Eyes Portrait Series in the OG style.

sr-9f65f8-75.description: The honor of creating a multi-generational portrait for the Oyxabaten tribe is immense. The intent was to show how grandfather, father and son together hold the honor of the tribe and lands they have inhabited for over 500 Years. If he were alive, Ubaraja would be 99 years old. Born in 1923, he was one of the main leaders and warriors of his people, also founder of Aldeia Linha 9, strategically implanted to defend the territory. The front of the portrait shows the wisdom and strength of the tribal leaders. As you turn around to the back of the portrait you see the tribal family who together thrive. The family overlooks the forests which they cherish. Artwork by Coldie: Genesis Decentral Eyes AR/VR portrait. - Concept: ©MONOGRAMA - #GUARDIAN1 - Geo Location: https://bit.ly/3JASzd9

sr-b932a7-33750.description:
It was 2020 and BTC Conference was coming back to San Francisco. After an amazing 2019 BTC Conference that united some OG crypto artists from around the world, we were all gearing up for the next year. Everyone was getting physical art ready for the gallery exhibition. My plan was to create a physical poster as well as a digital NFT as part of my physical art exhibit. 

COVID was becoming more and more of a worldwide issue and as time was getting closer and closer to the event date,  everyone was hoping we could still have our gathering. Sadly, the San Francisco event was canceled and this poster never saw the light of day. 

Two years later, in alignment with the dates of BTC 2020  and BTC 2022 in Miami,  I am releasing this work as a 1/1 NFT. The genesis collector will also recieve a 1/1 signed physical print (13.3" x 20") printed on Hahnemuhle paper.

sr-b932a7-37869.description:
After years of mining the frigid streams looking for the sweet crypto treasure, it is time to stake the claim. Commemorating the historical shift from proof of work to proof of stake, this release is the pair set of the original 2018 release that has now become iconic in the crypto art space. 
As you can see, some things are the same, while other things have changed. Many Easter eggs are hidden in the composition and invite the view to study the original Proof of Work next to this artwork to compare. Just as it is with life, the only constant is change. 

Animated version 
Dimensions: 4874 × 6074

sr-b932a7-43335.description: Time is like sand. Brings endless memories but blows by. What will the sands of time define? Cityscapes and mortal fate. Lambos with million dollar license plates. Camels living theirs lives reminding us of a more simple time. As you walk by, what will you define? Your journey. Your time. We are finite. Be Kind.

sr-892a1e-2.description: Chair of the SEC Gary Gensler has been single-handedly attacking crypto and squirming in testimony as he attemps to  prop up the traditional cartel financial system. His face changes shape, but the intent remains.

sr-892a1e-3.description: As the CEO of Coinbase, Brian has remained at the forefront of onboarding the masses to crypto. He has notably spearheaded the development of Base, Coinbase's layer 2 solution on the Ethereum network. Base is quickly becoming a market leader, providing new opportunities for decentralized commerce and innovation. This artwork combines 10 distinct images to form a decentralized, animated stereoscopic 3D portrait.

sr-892a1e-4.description:
Jack Dorsey is an American entrepreneur and the co-founder of Twitter and Block Inc. As a strong advocate for Bitcoin and decentralized technologies, Jack has integrated these into Block’s ecosystem and supports various Bitcoin initiatives. His eccentric image, commitment to decentralization and involvement in controversial causes, like the rumored donation to Julian Assange, defines his unique persona.

This ‘Safe Passage’ variant is created by combining a variety of photos of Dorsey along with his tweet to Julian Assange (“safe passage through”) which was sent at the same moment 8 BTC were transferred to Assange for his plane flight home. The photos were all recombined to created a decentralized 3D collage portrait in a glitch style which symbolizes the matrix that Assange is traveling through with the support of his friend Jack.

sr-892a1e-5.description:
Minted on Inauguration Day 1/20/2025, never before has a sitting president aligned with Bitcoin and crypto overall the way Trump has done through a variety of drops across multiple chains. The lastest meme coin drop $TRUMP on Solana turns out after much hype to look to be a shitter. While he has floated the idea of a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve for the United States Government, at this time it has not become a reality. He also has not released Ross on Day One which was a driving force for his support within the Bitcoin community. Will Trump follow through with his campaign promises? Time will tell. 

The play on words within this piece...

This Decentral Eyes portrait is created using a variety of visual assets that are recombined to created a decentralized animated portrait.
